status.successBody: You can now see all visa & sponsorship info on company pages. It may take a few seconds to show.
status.cancelBody: No problem — you can start anytime.

cancel.a: If you paid on the web, cancel from “Manage subscription” on this page. If you paid in the app (App Store or Google Play), cancel in that store's subscriptions. You keep Premium until the paid period ends.

app.q: How is paying in the app different?
app.a: Same benefits. App store fees make the in-app price a little higher, so the web is cheaper. Wherever you pay, Premium opens on the web and in the app for the same account.

refund.a: Cancel during the 7-day free trial and you won't be charged. For a refund after payment, email info@misaeng.com. In-app purchases follow Apple's and Google's refund policies.

data.q: Where does the data come from?
data.a: H-1B (LCA) and green card (PERM) filings published by the U.S. Department of Labor's Office of Foreign Labor Certification. They are filings, not hires or approved visas.
